This is a conflict about land, freedom, security, equality and self-determination. Peace requires justice, accountability and respect for the rights of both Palestinians and Israelis.

We need justice for peace. And we need leaders willing to enforce the law consistently.

Chris Van Hollen has demonstrated that willingness. Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries have not.
